text:
Alyssa Chen: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth QBR scheduled for Tue 10am PT. Need a short cost slide: token econ, 90d spend forecast, and any budget-alert history. Can folks drop numbers/notes here?

Jamal Reed: I can own the slide. Need the last 30d spend + any anomalies. @emily can you pull the token breakdown?

Emily Park: pulling now. FYI there was an embedding spike last week tied to batch job retries. Will post numbers in a sec.

ops-bot: ALERT: novahealth-prod exceeded 80% of monthly reserved spend yesterday (auto-notify to #customer-success). Link: https://console.redwood/invoices/nh-332

Marco Rivera: Confirmed — customer mentioned two big import jobs on 3/8 that doubled embedding calls. They switched to smaller batches afterwards.

Emily Park: numbers: ```Last 30d:
- total_tokens (gen+emb): 14,720,392
- embeddings tokens: 6,900,112
- generation tokens: 7,820,280
- billed USD (30d): $7,860
Anomaly: 3/8 embedding retries ~ 420k extra tokens (est $235)```

Priya Patel: From enablement: customer plans a demo spike next month (expected +40% queries for 3 days). Recommend we set temp quota or rate-limit route during demo.

Alyssa Chen: Good call. Can we create budget alert steps and suggested mitigations for the slide? (e.g., set 70% alert + 90% throttle, recommend quantized model for embeddings).

Emily Park: Suggested mitigations for slide: 
- 70%/85%/95% budget alerts (email + slack)
- auto-fallback to quantized-embed-v2 for non-critical routes
- prefix KV caching for repeated prompts
- one-time limit for demo (burst cap 2x for 72h)

Jamal Reed: I'll add a short forecast table. Emily/Marco — can you confirm conservative 90d forecast with demo spike?

Marco Rivera: Conservative forecast with demo: ```90d forecast (conservative):
- baseline (no spike): $22,500
- with demo spike: $29,100
Notes: assume +40% for 3 days in month 1, then baseline growth 5% m/m```

Emily Park: Confirmed those numbers match my model. I'll attach the CSV export to the QBR folder.

Alyssa Chen: Also capture customer feedback: they asked for clearer cost-per-embed line item and an option to cap daily embedding spend. Marco, can you ask product team for cap feature backlog item?

Marco Rivera: Will raise it in product sync; backfill here once prioritized.

Priya Patel: Offer for enablement: we'll run a 30-min session with NovaHealth engineers to show batching best practices and how to switch to quantized models. Scheduled placeholder: Mon before QBR.

Jamal Reed: Action items: 
1) Jamal — build cost slide (owner)
2) Emily — attach CSV + add alert screenshots
3) Marco — collect customer ask + product ticket
4) Priya — schedule enablement session
5) Alyssa — finalize QBR deck and send to AM by EOD Fri

Alyssa Chen: Perfect. Tag me when slide draft is ready. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: NOTE: Budget alert created for novahealth: thresholds [70%, 85%, 95%] — created by @Emily Park

Emily Park: Done. CSV + 30/60/90 forecasts uploaded to: https://drive.redwood/qbrs/novahealth/costs

Marco Rivera: Customer quote to include on slide: "We love the latency but need clearer per-embed cost to plan demos."

Alyssa Chen: Nice. That quote + mitigations should make a concise cost slide. I'll draft and ping for reviews.

Jamal Reed: Thanks team. If anyone spots an error in the numbers ping me before EOD Fri.
